articles.title: When a bushfire comes, what happens if the phones go dead?
articles.summary: During the Black Summer bushfires, mobile phone failures cut people off from rescue services and emergency warnings. To address the risk of telecommunications outages during disasters, one community has developed a plan to maintain safety when mobile networks fail. On January 8, 2026, Victorian authorities issued a catastrophic fire rating warning for the following day.
